messages:
Anya (CSM): Morning team — quick internal kickoff for Sparrow Labs onboarding. Meeting with their leads at 2pm PT today. I want alignment on stakeholders, success criteria, and an initial 30d timeline.

Mike R.: SGTM. I can take lead on the integration checklist and own API readiness.

Jordan - Solutions: I'll prepare the demo flow and a short runbook for common edge cases. Need to confirm model variant they want pinned.

Lee (Tech PM): Do we have their network/KMS constraints yet? If they're going VPC we need the onboarding packet filled before the private deploy request.

Anya (CSM): Noted — customer mentioned KMS via AWS KMS, wants private later but starting hosted. I'll ask them to confirm by EOD.

Mike R.: Quick checklist I'm thinking (will share in thread):
```
- ✅ API keys issued (blocked if not)
- ✅ Example data + sample prompts received
- ⬜ Model variant decision (gpt-like / open variant)
- ⬜ Latency SLOs + peak qps
- ⬜ Auth / routing policy (IP allowlist / token scoping)
- ⬜ Access to test dataset for evals
- ⬜ Training / enablement session scheduled
```

Jordan - Solutions: For success criteria let's propose: 1) integration demo with sample queries returns acceptable quality (>= baseline eval), 2) sustained 95th percentile latency < 800ms on dev traffic, 3) docs + playbook in customer GH repo, 4) enablement completed for 5+ engineers. Thoughts?

Lee (Tech PM): Those look good. Add: a fallback plan if we hit throughput issues (route to smaller model or dedicated burst). I can draft the routing policy snippet.

Anya (CSM): Perfect — I'll propose those to Sparrow and map owners. I'll own customer success criteria & enablement scheduling. Mike owns API/integration. Jordan owns demo + runbook. Lee owns routing/fallback + infra notes.

onboard-bot: Reminder: create onboarding ticket in JIRA and tag #customer-success — template: https://redwood-internal.example/onboard-template

Anya (CSM): Putting tentative 30d timeline here:
- Day 0: Kickoff (today)
- Day 1-3: API keys, sample data ingestion, basic smoke tests
- Day 4-10: Integration + demo flow, runbook draft
- Day 11-18: Eval runs, latency tuning, routing policy review
- Day 19-25: Enablement sessions, documentation handover
- Day 26-30: Go/No-go review + next-phase plan (private deploy if requested)

Mike R.: I'll add a note in the JIRA for "API key rotation window" and request test tokens from infra.

Jordan - Solutions: Demo checklist: happy-path, long-context, tool call fallback, and a small A/B prompt test. I'll attach examples in the doc.

Lee (Tech PM): I'll schedule a 30min pre-call at 1:10pm PT to run through the slide deck and live demo handoffs. Who can join?

Anya (CSM): @Mike R., @Jordan - Solutions please join 1:10. If anyone else can hop on for 10 min please do.

Mike R.: On calendar.

Jordan - Solutions: On calendar, will have runbook link ready.

Anya (CSM): Last thing — renewal-risk note: Sparrow flagged vendor consolidation as a concern. We should capture quick wins in first 30d that show latency/cost benefits vs their current setup. Jordan/Mike, can you point to two measurable wins to highlight in the go/no-go?

Mike R.: I can run a token-cost estimate and a small perf comparison on their sample workload — will have numbers by Day 10.

Jordan - Solutions: I'll capture quality delta on a 200-prompt eval and highlight intent-match improvements.

Anya (CSM): Awesome. I'll summarize this after the 1:10 dry run and post the finalized owner matrix + JIRA link here. :thumbsup:

onboard-bot: Created JIRA ticket CS-12458: Sparrow Onboarding — draft checklist added.

Anya (CSM): Closing thread for prep — will update after the pre-call. Thanks team! :rocket:
